GREGTHESPIRE-TRUSTY_BACKPACK.description: At the start of each combat, gain [blue]3[/blue] [gold]Storage[/gold].
GREGTHESPIRE-TRUSTY_BACKPACK.title: Trusty Backpack
GREGTHESPIRE-FANNY_PACK.description: At the start of each combat, gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Storage[/gold].
GREGTHESPIRE-FANNY_PACK.flavor: Some extra space, for when you need it.
GREGTHESPIRE-FANNY_PACK.title: Fanny Pack
GREGTHESPIRE-BONE_SAW.description: Whenever an enemy dies, play a card in your [gold]Stash[/gold].
GREGTHESPIRE-BONE_SAW.title: Bone Saw
GREGTHESPIRE-MOLDY_SANDWICH.description: Every time you play an Attack or Skill, [gold]Enchant[/gold] it with [purple]Infested[/purple] for the remainder of combat.
GREGTHESPIRE-MOLDY_SANDWICH.flavor: You're going to be sick, but at least your enemies will be, too.
GREGTHESPIRE-MOLDY_SANDWICH.title: Moldy Sandwich
GREGTHESPIRE-THICK_WALLET.flavor: Could probably stop a bullet, if you were lucky.
GREGTHESPIRE-THICK_WALLET.title: Thick Wallet
GREGTHESPIRE-CLOCHE.description: The first [gold]Snack[/gold] you play each turn is played an extra time.
GREGTHESPIRE-CLOCHE.title: Cloche
GREGTHESPIRE-MAGNIFYING_GLASS.descriptio: Every [blue]3[/blue] turns, put a card in your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold] on top of your deck
GREGTHESPIRE-MAGNIFYING_GLASS.flavor: The Hive won't know what hit 'em.
GREGTHESPIRE-MAGNIFYING_GLASS.title: Magnifying Glass
GREGTHESPIRE-DEAD_RINGER.description: If you take no unblocked attack damage during the enemy turn, gain [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Confidence[/gold] at the start of your turn.
GREGTHESPIRE-DEAD_RINGER.flavor: The bell tolls for rats and men alike.
GREGTHESPIRE-DEAD_RINGER.title: Dead Ringer
GREGTHESPIRE-STURDY_KNAPSACK.description:
At the start of each combat, gain [blue]5[/blue] [gold]Storage[/gold]. 
You may now [gold]Store[/gold] at rest sites.
GREGTHESPIRE-STURDY_KNAPSACK.flavor: An improvement on the classics, with just as much style.
GREGTHESPIRE-STURDY_KNAPSACK.title: Sturdy Knapsack
